description: Save a link or a text note to the user's MarkIt library. Pass a URL to save a web page (MarkIt fetches and reads the page), or plain text to save a note. Optionally attach a note - your own context, e.g. why it matters or how it relates to the conversation - and, for a text note, a title. MarkIt reads, auto-categorizes, and indexes the item in the background so it turns up in later searches. Saving a URL already in the library does nothing.

content.description: A URL to save (the page is fetched and saved as a link), or the text of a note to save.

note.description: Optional context to store with the item (e.g. why it's relevant).

title.description: Optional title. For a note it is used as-is. For a URL it replaces the page title and skips the AI headline, so leave it empty unless the user asked for a specific title.

name: save_item
title: Save an item
